title: PKCE S256 check for the companion-app sign-in
spec: Implement oidc::pkce_challenge and oidc::verify_pkce as their doc comments say. Validate the verifier (VERIFIER_MIN..=VERIFIER_MAX bytes, each in A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~) else Err(BadVerifier); hash with sha2::Sha256; encode with base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD. verify_pkce returns false for an invalid verifier and otherwise compares the computed and given challenge bytes with subtle::ConstantTimeEq (different lengths are simply false). No new dependencies.
